title: Freemax Rexa Duomax Replacement Vape Pods - 2ml
description: Freemax Rexa Duomax Pods are precision-engineered to work seamlessly with all Rexa Series pod vape kits. Featuring Freemax’s advanced Duomax mesh structure and high-performance tea fibre cotton, these 2ml pods deliver a refined balance of flavour and coil longevity. Each Duomax pod is built to last through up to 100ml of Freebase or 60ml of Nic Salt e-liquid, delivering consistent performance across approximately 50 or 30 full refills before natural flavour degradation occurs. The slide-to-fill top cap makes refilling clean and convenient, while the nano-coated internals help resist leaks and maintain coil integrity throughout use. Available in 0.4ohm or 0.6ohm options, Rexa Duomax Pods support a wide range of vaping styles from MTL (mouth-to-lung) to RDL (restricted direct-lung), depending on your device settings. They're fully compatible with the entire Rexa Series — including the Lite , Nano , S , SQ , Pro , and Smart kits — and are ideal for use with either Nic Salt or Freebase e-liquids. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
